visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand waving closely in front of a smartphone camera lens initiates the shot, quickly pulling back to reveal three individuals—two women and one man—sitting in the front row of an upper seating tier. They are dressed in winter attire, including beanies and scarves, smiling brightly and waving with high energy towards the camera. The stadium background is filled with hundreds of attendees holding glowing light sticks in various colors, primarily red and green. (2) The camera pans smoothly to the right, capturing the vast scale of the indoor arena. The seating rows are packed with a diverse crowd, all focused on the distant stage. The lighting is dominated by vibrant blue and purple hues illuminating the lower sections, while the ceiling structure shows rows of spotlights. Signs for 'vivo' and 'OT CAFE' are visible on the structural partitions. (3) The perspective shifts upwards and further right as a cut transitions to a focused view of a massive LED screen on stage. The screen displays a high-definition video of a male performer with bleached blonde hair wearing a shimmering, lime-green sequined jacket. He is singing passionately into a microphone, flanked by female backup dancers in synchronized outfits. The digital background on screen features colorful, stylized urban graphics and floral patterns. (4) The final segment zooms in tighter on the singer on the large screen as he performs a signature dance move, touching his fingers to his forehead. Subtitles in Chinese appear at the bottom of the frame, matching the lyrics being sung. The stadium lights fluctuate between warm yellow and cool blue, synchronized with the rhythmic pulse of the performance.
